test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Vicky asked them whether they wanted to join the party he had organised.

options.text: Vicky said to them, “Do you want to join the party I have organised?”
Vicky said to him, “Do you want to join the party I organised?”
Vicky said to them, “Do you want to join the party I organised?”
Vicky said to him, “Do you want to join the party I have organised?”

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Vicky asked them whether they wanted to join the party he had organised" is in reported speech.
 
• Converting this to direct speech, we have: "Vicky said to them, “Do you want to join the party I have organised?" Which is option 1.
 
• Remember, when changing reported questions into direct speech, the reporting verb changes to "said" (or "asked"), and the sentence ends with a question mark.
 
• We also reverse the subject and auxiliary verb position to form a question.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Option 2 and option 4 confuse the number, discussing **"him" **when the original sentence was about **"them".**
 
• In option 3, past perfect **"organised"** is incorrectly used instead of present perfect **"have organised".**
